name: program-runtime.research-attention-delivery
purpose: Reconcile one explicitly selected enrolled effort's retained decisions with Notification Hub asks and delivery receipts.

effort_ref.description: Exact enrolled Agent Manager effort identity.

decision_page_token.description: Opaque continuation for the same effort.

include_board.description: Also inspect the slower owner board's needs-operator projection.

assumptions: One decision page and the optional effort board are not a complete research attention inventory.
A published event is not proof of an ask or delivery.
invariants: Read only; never send, answer, or change a decision.
Join only exact source, event type, and requester identity.
Missing, truncated, unavailable, and unlinked evidence remains unknown; no absence claim covers the attention view.
At most 16 decisions and one bounded ask search page per decision.

signals.items: Bounded retained decisions and owner-observed delivery evidence
signals.next_page_token: Opaque owner continuation; follow until empty
signals.attention_view_coverage: Always unknown; the human index is not an authoritative machine inventory
